name: 84315 · Hooper, UT
findings: ZIP 84315 (Hooper) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 3 organizations.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
